prompt: A matrix run failed in 3 of 10 combinations. What is the cheapest path to a clean, fully green run?
explanation: Re-run failed jobs recreates exactly the failed combinations, keeping the passed ones green in place. Re-running everything burns the minutes you already paid for, and deleting a run erases the evidence you were about to learn from.

options.text: Re-run all jobs and hope the flaky ones pass this time
Re-run failed jobs — only the 3 failed combinations execute again
Edit the matrix to drop the failing combinations
Delete the run and push a new commit
